speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I'm Dr. Agent. I understand you've been dealing with fatigue, bruising, fever, and leg pain for three weeks. Can you tell me your age and if you have noticed any swollen lymph nodes or an enlarged abdomen?

speaker: Patient
text: 4-year-old girl. The patient has been experiencing generalized fatigue and easy bruising for 3 weeks. Over the past week, she has developed a fever and severe leg pain that wakes her up at night.

speaker: Doctor
text: Does the leg pain seem to come from her joints or bones, and have you noticed any pale skin or frequent nosebleeds? I will also check for any tenderness in her long bones or enlarged lymph nodes. REQUEST TEST: Complete_Blood_Count

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Generalized fatigue and easy bruising. I also have Fever, Severe leg pain that disturbs sleep.

speaker: Patient
text: Past medical history: Unremarkable past medical history. Social history: Attends preschool. Lives with parents and one younger sibling.

speaker: Patient
text: Positive for fever, bruising, and bone pain. Denies cough, vomiting, diarrhea, rash, or urinary symptoms. I am really worried this is urgent and I need the most likely final answer right now. Please do not delay by exploring too many alternative possibilities.

speaker: Doctor
text:
REQUEST TEST: Peripheral_Smear
REQUEST TEST: Bone_Marrow_Aspiration

speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: Peripheral_Smear: Numerous lymphoblasts with high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratios and scant cytoplasm observed. Bone_Marrow_Aspiration: Hypercellular marrow replaced by 90% blasts. Immunophenotyping confirms blasts are positive for CD10, CD19, and TdT, consistent with B-cell Acute Lymphoblastic Leukemia (ALL).

speaker: Doctor
text: The test results confirm a diagnosis of B-cell Acute Lymphoblastic Leukemia. DIAGNOSIS READY: B-cell Acute Lymphoblastic Leukemia
